name: disco
//: A pool of eight people who dance, and the room decides how many of them are on. It was two sets of four, split by hand so they would be drawn large; the dealing does that now, and better — it takes the largest size the band allows and fills it.
//heights: Traced from a drawing, so the pen is measured off it and taken to three dots.
//marks: Each says where it stands along the row. For people the pitch is not a sound but an order, and the order is the one thing that has to hold still: dealt afresh every time with no pitch, the same four would come up in a different order and read as four different people.
